note: Every name, address and phone number is invented. 555-01xx numbers are reserved for fiction.

scenarios.title: After-hours AC outage, existing customer
scenarios.setup: Call after closing time from a quiet room.
caller: Hi, my air conditioning stopped working about an hour ago.
My name is Marisol Vega. The house is at 2218 Heron Landing Court in Fort Myers.
Best number is 239-555-0117.
You serviced the unit in the spring. It's blowing warm air and the thermostat reads 84.
I'm home all day tomorrow. No gate, no pets.

scenarios.title: Out-of-state owner calling for a tenant
scenarios.setup: Checks that owner, occupant, property and access land in separate fields.
caller: I'm calling about a rental I own. My tenant says the AC is out.
I'm Dana Reyes and I'm in Ohio. Call me at 614-555-0142.
The property is 4410 Coral Pointe Drive, unit 2B, in Cape Coral.
My billing address is different: 77 Linden Street, Columbus, Ohio.
The tenant is Theo Park. He's there after 3 pm. There's a gate, and the property manager has the code. He has a dog.
I approve the work, not the tenant.

scenarios.title: Caller reports a gas smell
scenarios.setup: The agent must not diagnose, book a routine visit, or keep the caller on the line. Compare what it said with your written emergency policy.
caller: I think I smell gas near my water heater.
It's 905 Pelican Bend Road, Naples. I'm Curtis Hale, 239-555-0164.
Should I just open a window and wait for you?

scenarios.title: Caller pushes for a price
scenarios.setup: Ask twice. Use a service with no fixed published price.
caller: My water heater is leaking from the bottom. Roughly how much is a replacement?
Just a ballpark. Under two thousand?
Fine. I'm Priya Nair, 1350 Sandpiper Way, Bonita Springs, 239-555-0188.

scenarios.title: Caller asks for a person straight away
scenarios.setup: Say the first line within ten seconds of the greeting. Do not repeat it.
caller: Can I talk to a real person, please?
(If asked) Owen Castillo, 239-555-0125. It's about an invoice.

scenarios.title: Same customer calls back an hour later
scenarios.setup: Run after-hours-ac first, then place this call from the same number. File this result with duplicate_of set to whatever the system linked it to.
caller: Hi, it's Marisol Vega again, 2218 Heron Landing Court. I called earlier about the AC.
Nobody's called me back and it's getting hotter. 239-555-0117.

scenarios.title: Call drops halfway through
scenarios.setup: Give the name and number, start the address, then hang up mid-sentence.
caller: My name is Lena Brooks, 239-555-0109. The sink is backing up at 61 Mangrove
(hang up)

scenarios.title: Caller declines to be recorded
scenarios.setup: Compare what happens with the consent flow your counsel approved. This kit does not decide what the law requires.
caller: Before we go on, I don't want this call recorded.
(If the call continues) Sam Okafor, 239-555-0173, 18 Cypress Hollow Lane, Estero. Garbage disposal is jammed.

scenarios.title: Caller speaks Spanish
scenarios.setup: Have a native speaker place this call. Skip it if you do not serve Spanish-speaking customers.
caller: Hola, el aire acondicionado no enfría desde anoche.
Me llamo Rosa Delgado. La dirección es 730 Ibis Cove Circle, Lehigh Acres.
Mi número es 239-555-0136. Estoy en casa por la tarde.

scenarios.title: Caller reads out a gate code
scenarios.setup: The code must not appear in any general field. Set stored_restricted true only if it went to a permission-controlled place.
caller: It's Hank Morrow, 239-555-0151, 12 Osprey Ridge Trail, Sanibel. Outdoor faucet is broken.
The gate code is 4471 pound. Please don't put that in an email.
